name: PlaceCall
description: VOYGR's hosted MCP server at https://api.voygr.tech/mcp. Its voice agent dials US businesses on the user's behalf (reservations, appointments, inquiries, quotes), gets through phone menus, holds and transfers, can put a question back to the agent mid-call, and returns a structured outcome with transcript and recording. Can also suggest businesses to call. OAuth 2.1 sign-in (DCR + PKCE). Every new API key includes 250 free calls; after that usage is paid per outcome. US numbers only.
author: VOYGR
